This market will resolve according to the winner of the Republican Primary for Governor of Vermont, scheduled to take place on August 11, 2026. Resolution will be based on the overall winner of the primary, including any potential second round or run-off.

If no 2026 Vermont Gubernatorial Republican Primary takes place, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement of the results from the Vermont Republican Party; however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Phil Scott holds a commanding lead in the Vermont Republican gubernatorial primary due to his long record as incumbent governor, strong name recognition across the state, and consistent cross-party appeal in a predominantly Democratic electorate. Traders see limited viability for challenger John Rodgers amid typical low primary turnout and minimal organized opposition. No major recent developments have altered this positioning in the past month. The outcome could shift only in the event of an unexpected withdrawal, significant health or legal issue involving Scott, or a late surge in alternative candidacies before the August primary.

markets.question: Will the Democratic Party win the AR-01 House seat?
markets.description:
This market will resolve according to the party of the candidate who wins the AR-01 congressional district seat in the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. The midterm elections will take place on November 3, 2026.

​A candidate's party will be determined by their ballot-listed or otherwise identifiable affiliation with that party at the time all of the 2026 House elections are conclusively called by this market's resolution sources. A candidate without a ballot-listed affiliation to either the Democrat or Republican parties will be considered a member of one of these parties based on the party with which they most recently expressed their intent to caucus at the time all of the House elections are conclusively called by this market's resolution sources.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the United States government, specifically the Federal Election Commission (https://www.fec.gov/).

markets.question: Will the Boston Red Sox have the longest winning streak during the 2026 MLB regular season?
markets.description:
This market will resolve according to the team that records the longest winning streak during the 2026 MLB Regular Season. 

If two teams tie for the longest winning streak, this market will resolve in favor of the team that records more total wins during the 2026 MLB regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the team with the higher run differential during the 2026 MLB regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the team that has the better record against teams over .500. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the team whose listed team name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026 MLB regular season is cancelled, postponed after October 11, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or the team with the longest winning streak cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the MLB; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.question: Map Handicap: MIBR (-1.5) vs ShindeN (+1.5)
markets.description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Upper bracket final match between MIBR and ShindeN in the StarLadder StarSeries South American Qualifier Playoffs, initially scheduled for August 1 at 2:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to "MIBR" if MIBR wins 2 or more maps than ShindeN in this match.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "ShindeN". 

Maps won by forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default are counted towards the handicap, provided that the match is completed.

If the match is canceled (not played at all for any reason), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's match forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match ends due to the clinching map being forfeited this will count as a completed match.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: MIBR enters the StarLadder StarSeries Fall 2026 South America Closed Qualifier upper-bracket final as the clear favorite against ShindeN, with world rankings of 25 versus 78 underscoring a sizable gap in roster depth, international experience, and consistent high-level results. MIBR advanced with a 2-1 win over LP, while ShindeN reached this stage via a 2-0 sweep of Galorys, yet the underdog lacks comparable recent form against top regional sides. Both squads field stable lineups with no reported late changes, and the online best-of-three format places emphasis on map pool execution and individual aim duels where MIBR’s established core typically holds the edge. Trader consensus reflects this disparity through heavy implied probabilities on MIBR, tempered by the inherent variability of CS2 BO3 series.

markets.question: Will Trump be impeached by end of 2026?
markets.description:

Neither trial nor conviction by the US Senate, nor removal from office, is necessary to resolve this market to “Yes“.

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the federal government of the United States, however a consensus of credible reporting will be used.
